description: Build the student-facing assessment experience as web pages/routes: home/landing, the 60-question RIASEC Likert assessment with per-item response-time capture, cohort scoping via URL (?cohort=CODE or /g/{code}), a results screen with an interactive hexagonal RIASEC radar chart (SVG/Canvas port of RadarChart.kt), career-match ranking, and a careers explorer with detail view. Persist completed sessions and responses to Neon via server actions/route handlers. Depends on FEAT-001 (engine, types, seed, db).
steps: Add a home/landing route (web/app/page.tsx) in Spanish describing OrientApp and starting an assessment, matching the tone of the Android HomeScreen. Include navigation to the assessment, careers explorer, and (for staff) admin.

Build the assessment route web/app/assessment/page.tsx (client component) rendering the 60 questions from seed data on a 1-5 Likert scale, one-at-a-time or paged, capturing timeSpentMs per item (timestamp when shown vs answered). Read cohort scope from the URL search param `cohort` (e.g. /assessment?cohort=ING-2026-A) and also support a /g/[code] route (web/app/g/[code]/page.tsx) that redirects/loads the assessment scoped to that cohort code. Collect optional student name/email.

On submit, compute scores/quality/careerMatches client-side or via a server action using the ported engine, then persist: create a server action or route handler web/app/api/sessions/route.ts (or web/lib/actions/*) that inserts into assessment_sessions and assessment_responses using web/lib/db.ts. Store dominantCode (getDominantCode(3)), dominantSummary (getDominantProfileDescription), reliabilityLevel, per-dimension scores, top career title/affinity, cohortCode, studentName, studentEmail. Generate a session id (uuid).

Build the results route web/app/results/[sessionId]/page.tsx showing: the hexagonal RIASEC radar chart, the 6 dimension scores with their dimension colors, the reliability level + any Spanish warning message, dominant profile description, and the ranked career matches with affinity % and matchLevel labels. Load session data from Neon by id (lazy DB).

Port the radar chart to web/components/RadarChart.tsx: a hexagonal 6-axis radar (R,I,A,S,E,C) drawn with SVG (or canvas), plotting the normalized 0-100 scores, using the per-dimension colors from types. Reference app/src/main/java/com/example/ui/components/RadarChart.kt for the visual layout (axis labels, grid rings).

Build the careers explorer route web/app/careers/page.tsx listing all 16 careers (from seed) with area, description, key skills, and future trends; and a career detail view (component or route) equivalent to CareerDetailSheet.kt. If a diagnostic session is present, show affinity for each career.
Ensure all new pages typecheck and the production build passes without a live DB (guard any DB reads so build/prerender does not require a connection; use dynamic rendering where needed).
acceptance_criteria: Assessment page renders all 60 questions on a 1-5 scale and records a timeSpentMs per answered item.
Visiting /assessment?cohort=ING-2026-A and /g/ING-2026-A both scope the assessment to that cohort code.
Submitting a completed assessment inserts one assessment_sessions row and 60 assessment_responses rows (verified by code path / SQL, exercised against a real Neon only at runtime).
Results page renders the hexagonal radar with 6 axes and the ranked career list with Spanish matchLevel labels.
`cd web && npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` pass without DATABASE_URL.
findings: Built the full student-facing experience under web/. New global theme (web/app/globals.css) + shared layout with top nav (web/app/layout.tsx). Home landing (web/app/page.tsx) in Spanish showing the 6 RIASEC dimensions. Assessment: web/components/AssessmentClient.tsx (client) renders all 60 seed questions one-at-a-time on a 1-5 Likert scale, captures timeSpentMs per item via a shownAt ref, collects optional name/email, auto-advances, and requires all 60 answered before submit. web/app/assessment/page.tsx reads ?cohort=CODE (Next 15 async searchParams) and web/app/g/[code]/page.tsx redirects to /assessment?cohort=CODE so QR links open the group's test. On submit, POST /api/sessions (web/app/api/sessions/route.ts, runtime=nodejs, dynamic=force-dynamic) re-validates answers against seed QUESTIONS, computes scores/quality/matchCareers/getDominantCode(3)/getDominantProfileDescription server-side, generates a uuid (node:crypto randomUUID), and persists via web/lib/sessions.ts (1 assessment_sessions row + 60 assessment_responses rows, parameterized query()). Results page web/app/results/[sessionId]/page.tsx (force-dynamic) loads the session from Neon at runtime, renders the hexagonal SVG radar (web/components/RadarChart.tsx, ported from RadarChart.kt: 5 concentric hex rings, per-dimension colored axis labels 'R (nn%)', filled score polygon, vertex halos), the 6 dimension bars in DIMENSION_META colors, reliability level + Spanish warning, dominant profile description, and the ranked career matches with affinity % and Spanish matchLevel labels. Careers explorer web/app/careers/page.tsx + web/components/CareersExplorer.tsx lists all 16 seed careers with area/description/keySkills and a detail modal (labels mirror CareerDetailSheet.kt: Descripcion Ocupacional / Entornos y Ambitos de Trabajo / Tendencias y Proyeccion Futura / Competencias y Habilidades Clave + ideal RIASEC bars). QR FEATURE (explicit user request): web/app/admin/page.tsx + web/components/AdminClient.tsx let staff create a survey group via server action web/lib/actions/cohorts.ts (inserts into cohort_groups) and immediately renders a QR code (web/components/QrCode.tsx via the qrcode npm lib, client-side data URL) pointing to {origin}/g/{CODE}; seed cohorts also show their QR so it works without a live DB. Added deps qrcode + @types/qrcode. DB access is 100% lazy/runtime: build with DATABASE_URL unset passes and correctly marks /results/[sessionId], /g/[code], /api/sessions as dynamic (f) while /, /careers, /admin stay static. Verification all green (DATABASE_URL unset): npm run typecheck, npm run test -- --run (20 tests), npm run lint (0 warnings), npm run build. Runtime DB inserts/reads cannot be exercised here (no live Neon creds) per the sandbox constraint. [REVIEW-FIX 2026-08-29] persistSession (web/lib/sessions.ts) now wraps the session INSERT and all response INSERTs in a single transaction via withTransaction, so a mid-write failure ROLLBACKs instead of leaving a partial/orphaned session behind a 201. Documented that cohortCode is intentionally stored unvalidated (open enrollment via QR /g/{CODE}); staff audit/filter by cohort in the admin panel.
